instrument.bootstrap_cluster: seed (pairs within one seed share theta_0 and are not independent)
instrument.a_definition: A(a,b) = score(theta->a->b) - score(theta->b->a) = I(a,b) - I(b,a); score is the world's raw objective score (info.score), never the shaped reward

control_group.semantics: absolute parameters + no precondition gate + no source switch + no clamping (docs/world-structure.md section 4)
control_group.score_oracle: the same world, probed with reset(x0=...) — the same true objective as the experimental group
control_group.control_starts_from: the same seeded theta_0 as the experimental group (read back from its obs)

v1_env_same_actions.note: v1's Env as literally shipped DOES clamp into the box, so it is not the control group of section 4 (which says 'no clamping'). This column only attributes the measured A to R2. It is not part of any sub-gate.
